groups.defect: The new TotalDocs() call iterates the cache without locking while the watch goroutine can concurrently write to that map.
groups.rationale: All three describe the same concurrent map iteration/write defect, pointing either to the cache assignment or to the new TotalDocs() caller. Synchronizing TotalDocs() resolves all three reports.

groups.defect: Narrowing BuildIndex's lock permits concurrent builds for the same key, causing cache replacement and competing creation of the same file-backed index.
groups.rationale: Both report the same missing serialization around index construction and the same cache and directory consequences. Their examples of concurrent callers differ, but a single per-key build synchronization fix addresses both.
